'''Guanomongers''' were a [[Diet/Legends|coprophagous]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Skye/Legends|Skye]]. They lived in the [[Entyrmion]], a vast cavern complex located under the [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] ranges of Skye, and fed on [[skingle]] feces.
